Gaussian kernel sum of weighted cells on a regular grid

Source: R/feature_plots.R
kde_grid.Rd

Cells are binned onto a regular grid over the axis limits (nearest grid point), and the binned weights are convolved with a Gaussian kernel, applied along x and along y as two matrix products. With unit weights, the result is a kernel density estimate up to a constant factor. Shared by `geom = "density"` of FeaturePlot_bioToolkit and by DensityDiffPlot_bioToolkit.

Usage

kde_grid(x, y, w, xlim, ylim, bandwidth, n_grid = 256L)

Arguments

x, y

Coordinates of the cells

w

Weights of the cells

xlim, ylim

Axis limits, which the grid spans

bandwidth

Kernel standard deviations along x and y

n_grid

Number of grid points along each axis

Value

An `n_grid` x `n_grid` matrix: rows along x, columns along y
